svg.title: Business agent and engineered AI service are different responsibilities
svg.desc: Copilot Studio provides a business interaction and workflow surface. A developer-owned catalog service processes files, runs models, preserves evidence and enforces a schema. Foundry supplies model and optional agent runtime capabilities plus evaluation and observability. Studio can call that service; this talk does not build that integration.

g.text: The distinction is where the engineering lives—not “Studio cannot.”
Optional service call shown conceptually · no Studio integration required for this talk
